        """NOAA Storm Events archive. Reports describe areas, not observed hub outages."""
        from collections import defaultdict
        from datetime import datetime,timezone
        from hashlib import sha256
        from io import BytesIO,TextIOWrapper
        from pathlib import Path
        from urllib.request import Request,urlopen
        import csv,gzip,json,re
        
        BASE='https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/swdi/stormevents/csvfiles/'
        # NOAA Storm Data standard event types; browseable even if no comparable magnitude exists.
        EVENT_TYPES=('Astronomical Low Tide','Avalanche','Blizzard','Coastal Flood','Cold/Wind Chill','Debris Flow','Dense Fog','Dense Smoke','Drought','Dust Devil','Dust Storm','Excessive Heat','Extreme Cold/Wind Chill','Flash Flood','Flood','Frost/Freeze','Funnel Cloud','Freezing Fog','Hail','Heat','Heavy Rain','Heavy Snow','High Surf','High Wind','Hurricane (Typhoon)','Ice Storm','Lake-Effect Snow','Lakeshore Flood','Lightning','Marine Hail','Marine High Wind','Marine Strong Wind','Marine Thunderstorm Wind','Rip Current','Seiche','Sleet','Storm Surge/Tide','Strong Wind','Thunderstorm Wind','Tornado','Tropical Depression','Tropical Storm','Tsunami','Volcanic Ash','Waterspout','Wildfire','Winter Storm','Winter Weather')
        
        class StormEventsClient:
            def __init__(self,cache_dir='data/cache/storm_events',transport=None):
                self.cache_dir=Path(cache_dir);self.transport=transport or self.download
            @staticmethod
            def download(url):
                with urlopen(Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'hub-weather-agent/0.1'}),timeout=30) as r:return r.read()
            def compare(self,locations,identifiers,hazards,end_year,periods,weights,frequency_benchmark,recovery_benchmark,recovery_days):
                try:index=self.transport(BASE).decode('utf-8')
                except Exception as exc:raise RuntimeError('NOAA storm event archive is unavailable; no event data substituted') from exc
                filenames={}
                for name in re.findall(r'StormEvents_details-ftp_v1\.0_d(\d{4})_c(\d{8})\.csv\.gz',index):
                    year,revision=name
                    if int(year)<=end_year and int(year)>=end_year-max(periods)+1 and revision>filenames.get(int(year),''):
                        filenames[int(year)]=revision
                if not filenames:raise RuntimeError('NOAA archive did not list any requested annual files')
                self.cache_dir.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
                selected_states={locations[i]['state'] for i in identifiers}
                # NOAA state names are accompanied by a numeric FIPS; use the trusted hub county prefix.
                state_codes={locations[i]['county_fips'][:2] for i in identifiers}
                records=defaultdict(list);availability=set();provenance=[]
                for year,revision in sorted(filenames.items()):
                    filename=f'StormEvents_details-ftp_v1.0_d{year}_c{revision}.csv.gz';path=self.cache_dir/filename
                    try:
                        raw=path.read_bytes() if path.exists() else self.transport(BASE+filename)
                        with gzip.open(BytesIO(raw),'rt',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace',newline='') as stream:
                            reader=csv.DictReader(stream)
                            if not {'EVENT_TYPE','STATE_FIPS','CZ_TYPE','CZ_FIPS','EVENT_ID'}<=set(reader.fieldnames or []):raise ValueError('Unexpected NOAA event archive format')
                            year_records=[]
                            for row in reader:
                                if row.get('EVENT_TYPE') in hazards and str(row.get('STATE_FIPS','')).zfill(2) in state_codes:year_records.append(row)
                        if not path.exists():path.write_bytes(raw)
                        for row in year_records:records[(year,str(row['STATE_FIPS']).zfill(2),row['EVENT_TYPE'])].append(row)
                        availability.add(year);provenance.append(dict(year=year,url=BASE+filename,sha256=sha256(raw).hexdigest()))
                    except (OSError,ValueError,EOFError):continue
                    except Exception:continue
                if not availability:raise RuntimeError('No requested NOAA storm event archives could be loaded')
                result={}
                for hazard in hazards:
                    hubs={}
                    for ident in identifiers:
                        loc=locations[ident];state=loc['county_fips'][:2];county=loc['county_fips'][2:]
                        state_rows=[(year,row) for year in availability for row in records[(year,state,hazard)]]
                        # Only county-only categories can be mapped without a forecast-zone polygon join.
                        county_only=bool(state_rows) and all(row.get('CZ_TYPE')=='C' for _,row in state_rows)
                        scope='county' if county_only else 'state'
                        selected=[(year,row) for year,row in state_rows if scope=='state' or str(row.get('CZ_FIPS','')).zfill(3)==county]
                        output={}
                        for n in periods:
                            years=set(range(end_year-n+1,end_year+1));covered=len(years&availability);rows=[row for year,row in selected if year in years]
                            unique={row['EVENT_ID']:row for row in rows if row.get('EVENT_ID')};event_count=len(unique);freq=event_count/max(covered,1)
                            magnitudes=[]
                            for row in unique.values():
                                try:
                                    if hazard=='Tornado':
                                        match=re.fullmatch(r'EF([0-5])',row.get('TOR_F_SCALE','').strip(),re.I)
                                        if match:magnitudes.append((int(match.group(1))+1)/6)
                                    elif hazard=='Hail':
                                        value=float(row['MAGNITUDE']);
                                        if value>0:magnitudes.append(min(value/3,1))
                                    elif hazard in ('Thunderstorm Wind','Strong Wind','High Wind'):
                                        value=float(row['MAGNITUDE']);
                                        if value>0:magnitudes.append(min(value/100,1))
                                except (ValueError,KeyError,TypeError):pass
                            severity=sum(magnitudes)/len(magnitudes)*100 if magnitudes else None
                            recovery=sum(recovery_days[min(int(m*3),2)] for m in magnitudes)/len(magnitudes) if magnitudes else None
                            score=round((weights[0]*min(100,freq/frequency_benchmark*100)+weights[1]*severity+weights[2]*min(100,recovery/recovery_benchmark*100))/100,1) if covered/n>=.8 and severity is not None and len(magnitudes)/max(event_count,1)>=.8 else None
                            output[str(n)]=dict(start=f'{end_year-n+1}-01-01',end=f'{end_year}-12-31',archive_years_available=covered,requested_years=n,coverage=covered/n,
                                event_reports=event_count,periods_per_year=round(freq,2),severity_observations=len(magnitudes),average_severity_score=round(severity,1) if severity is not None else None,
                                assumed_average_recovery_days=round(recovery,2) if recovery is not None else None,index=score,status='scored' if score is not None else 'unscored',geographic_scope=scope,
                                limitation='NOAA records are reports for a county or entire state, not incidents at this hub. Archived years do not establish reporting completeness. Categories and reports may overlap.')
                        hubs[ident]=dict(status='available',periods=output,evidence=dict(source='NOAA NCEI Storm Events',geographic_scope=scope,files=[x for x in provenance],retrieved_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()))
                    scopes={item['evidence']['geographic_scope'] for item in hubs.values()}
                    result[hazard]=dict(kind='reported_event',hubs=hubs,warning='Geographic scopes differ: statewide counts can cover events far from the hub.' if len(scopes)>1 else ('Statewide event reports can occur far from either hub.' if 'state' in scopes else 'County-level reports are not facility observations.'))
                return result

        class ComparisonTests(unittest.TestCase):
            def test_daily_thresholds_coverage_and_weighted_index(self):
                rows=[dict(date=f'2025-01-{i:02d}',snowfall_sum=v) for i,v in enumerate([5,15,0,25,0,None,0,0,None,0],1)]
                result=daily_measure(rows,date(2025,1,1),date(2025,1,10),'snow',[5,15,25],[1,3,7],10,14,[50,25,25])
                self.assertEqual(result['coverage'],.8)
                self.assertEqual(result['observed_periods'],2)
                self.assertEqual(result['assumed_average_recovery_days'],5)
                self.assertIsNotNone(result['index'])
                rows[0]['snowfall_sum']=None
                self.assertIsNone(daily_measure(rows,date(2025,1,1),date(2025,1,10),'snow',[5,15,25],[1,3,7],10,14,[50,25,25])['index'])
        
            def test_reject_duplicate_hubs_and_invalid_weights(self):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):HubComparisonRequest(locations=['a','a'],hazards=['snow'])
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):HubComparisonRequest(locations=['a','b'],hazards=['snow'],weights=[90,25,25])

    +## Two-hub comparison
    +
    +Open **Explore and compare**, select a location, then choose **Add to comparison**. Choose a second location, one or more daily weather measures and/or NOAA reported event types, then click **Compare hubs**. Red points are illustrative existing hubs; teal points are optional cities. They do not represent real facilities or service coverage. The map is limited to the contiguous United States.
    +
    +The result provides 5-, 10-, 20- and 30-year periods ending in the last complete calendar year. Daily weather requires at least 80% valid observations for each hub and period. Each period may use a different verified station or source; its evidence shows which. Consecutive daily threshold days form a period; a missing day breaks a period. NOAA reported-event coverage reflects available annual archives, not the completeness of reporting.
    +
    +The 0–100 planning index is not a probability of disruption. Its default weights are 50% frequency, 25% mean severity and 25% assumed recovery; the user can edit weights, bands, recovery and normalization benchmarks. For daily data, frequency is qualifying periods per year, normalized to 10 periods/year; severity is the mean peak band as a fraction of the three bands; recovery is the mean illustrative 1/3/7 days normalized to 14 days. Each component is capped at 100. No qualifying periods yield zero components, but do not demonstrate safety. The overall index is the mean of selected hazard indices and is withheld if either hub has any unscored hazard. Categories may overlap, and this index has not been calibrated to facility losses.
    +
    +All 48 standard NOAA event categories are offered. The first release scores hail size, wind magnitude and EF-rated tornadoes when enough physical magnitude values are present; other categories remain unscored but display available counts. NOAA archives can be slow to download the first time. County reports apply to counties, not facilities; statewide fallbacks can include events far away. A warning appears when statewide or mixed geographic scopes are used, including when scores are shown. Historical reporting practices, event classification and archive delays vary. NOAA data does not establish actual outage duration.
    +
    +The complete Open-Meteo variable catalog is linked from the settings. Only the five listed daily hazards have comparison scoring definitions; other provider variables are not silently scored.
    +
     ## Supported weather definitions

    docs/example-questions.md:68:The application uses three source families: Open-Meteo's ERA5 historical weather reanalysis, NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily station observations as a fallback for snowfall, precipitation and temperatures, and FEMA's National Risk Index for county-level hazard screening. NOAA fallback does not provide the app's maximum-wind metric. ERA5 and NOAA observations are not silently mixed in one comparison. These sources have broad United States coverage, including Alaska and Hawaii, but a specific coordinate, variable and time period may have inadequate station observations or missing FEMA data. The application has not validated every state or every location; coverage is reported per result. The seven illustrative hubs do not represent national hub coverage.

## Assistant

The two-hub comparison is implemented. Open **http://127.0.0.1:8767** and refresh the page.

The compact map now has red lights for seven illustrative existing hubs and teal lights for 18 optional cities. Select two locations, choose weather types, and compare the **5-, 10-, 20-, and 30-year** views. Results show frequency, severity, assumed recovery, and an adjustable planning index.

The index defaults to **50% frequency, 25% severity, and 25% recovery**. It is an illustrative score, not a disruption probability. NOAA event categories without sufficient comparable severity data remain unscored. When one result uses state-level records and the other county records, the app displays a prominent warning.

Verification passed: **89 tests**, **14 demo evaluations**, a real four-period daily-weather comparison, and a 30-year NOAA hail check. The first NOAA archive download took several minutes and used about 300 MB of cache.

    class StormEventsClient:
        def __init__(self,cache_dir='data/cache/storm_events',transport=None):

        @staticmethod
        def download(url):
            with urlopen(Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'hub-weather-agent/0.1'}),timeout=30) as r:return r.read()
        def compare(self,locations,identifiers,hazards,end_year,periods,weights,frequency_benchmark,recovery_benchmark,recovery_days,event_benchmarks=None):

                    filenames[int(year)]=revision

    import tempfile
    import unittest
    
    from app.agent import Service
    from app.hubs import seed_examples
    from app.storage import Store
    from evals.run import EvaluationFEMA, EvaluationWeather
    
    
    class RiskConversationTests(unittest.TestCase):
        def setUp(self):
            self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
            self.service = Service(Store(self.tmp.name + '/app.db'), EvaluationWeather(), mode='demo', fema=EvaluationFEMA())
            seed_examples(self.service.store)
    
        def tearDown(self):
            self.tmp.cleanup()
    
        def test_midwest_winter_ranking_and_stable_ties(self):
            result = self.service.chat({'message': 'Which hubs in the Midwest are most exposed to winter disruption?'})
            self.assertEqual(result['result_status'], 'complete')
            self.assertEqual([r['location_id'] for r in result['risk_results']], ['chicago', 'minneapolis', 'detroit'])
            self.assertIn('county', result['answer'])
            self.assertIn('not facility-specific', result['answer'])
            self.assertIn('Chicago ranks highest', result['answer'])
            self.assertIn('counties nationwide', result['answer'])
    
        def test_risk_followups_preserve_hubs_hazard_and_evidence(self):
            first = self.service.chat({'message': 'Compare Miami and Houston for hurricane and flood'})
            cid = first['conversation_id']
            second = self.service.chat({'message': 'Compare only flooding', 'conversation_id': cid})
            self.assertEqual(second['intent']['hazard'], 'flood')
            self.assertEqual(set(second['intent']['location_ids']), {'miami', 'houston'})
            explain = self.service.chat({'message': 'Why?', 'conversation_id': cid})
            self.assertEqual(explain['risk_results'], second['risk_results'])
            follow = self.service.chat({'message': 'What about Dallas?', 'conversation_id': cid})
            self.assertEqual(follow['intent']['hazard'], 'flood')
            self.assertEqual(follow['intent']['location_ids'], ['dallas'])
    
        def test_missing_data_stays_partial_in_explanation(self):
            class Missing(EvaluationFEMA):
                def fetch(self, county_fips):
                    result = super().fetch(county_fips)
                    result['scores']['coastal_flood'] = None

## Plan

# Unify chat and table comparisons

## Summary

Present the full comparison as a table and use the same frequency, severity, and assumed-recovery index in both chat and the comparison view. Fix regional questions so they include all matching locations rather than failing at five.

## Changes

- **Comparison table:** Show one row per hazard and period, with side-by-side hub values for frequency, severity, assumed recovery, index, coverage, and source. Keep definitions and provenance expandable. Display geographic-scope and incomplete-data warnings beside affected results.
- **Simpler controls:** Show a default scoring preset and keep editable weights, thresholds, and recovery assumptions in a collapsed advanced section. Chat and the comparison view use the same currently selected settings and weather source.
- **Chat ranking:** Refactor the calculation into a shared engine. A Midwest question includes all seven current Midwest catalog locations, including optional cities, and defaults to the most recent **10 complete years**. Regional rankings are not limited by the two-location comparison tray.
- **Winter questions:** Use snowfall and available ice-storm evidence. If ice-storm severity is unavailable, rank the common scored evidence, show ice-storm frequency separately, and label the winter result **partial**. Never treat missing severity as zero or describe the partial index as complete.
- **Hazard choices:** Reduce the visible choices to daily snow, precipitation, wind, heat, and cold, plus reported floods, hurricanes, tornadoes, and ice storms. Show other named-event evidence as unscored when comparable severity is unavailable.
- **Fair comparisons:** Use the same available scored hazards for every hub in a ranking. Report excluded hazards, missing locations, source differences, and county-versus-state fallback prominently. Keep the index distinct from probabilities and FEMA percentiles.
- **Cross-platform live startup:** Add a Python launcher that works on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Reuse an existing environment key or prompt with hidden input; support the existing provider, model, source, port, and evaluation options without saving the key.

## Verification

- Test a Midwest ranking with more than five locations, including optional cities, and verify the default 10-year period.
- Confirm chat and table return identical indices for the same hubs, period, source, and settings.
- Test partial snow/ice and flood results, missing data, mixed geographic scopes, and custom advanced settings.
- Verify table readability and scrolling on desktop and mobile, and ensure each result retains its evidence.
- Test the Python launcher with mocked environment and hidden input on supported platforms; rerun unit tests and demo evaluations. Run live Groq evaluation when a key is configured.

## Defaults

- Index weights remain **50% frequency, 25% severity, 25% assumed recovery**.
- A generic winter-disruption question includes snow and ice-storm evidence.
- If selected hazards cannot all be scored, the answer shows what can be scored and clearly identifies the incomplete components.

## Assistant

You can run the current app with Groq today by setting `GROQ_API_KEY` in your environment and running `python -m app.server`. On Windows, `.\scripts\start-live.ps1` prompts for the key without displaying it. The plan below adds the equivalent Python launcher for all supported operating systems.

            self.assertEqual(result['assumed_average_recovery_days'],5)
            self.assertIsNotNone(result['index'])
            rows[0]['snowfall_sum']=None
            self.assertIsNone(daily_measure(rows,date(2025,1,1),date(2025,1,10),'snow',[5,15,25],[1,3,7],10,14,[50,25,25])['index'])

    """Compare two illustrative hubs using transparent, non-probabilistic metrics."""
    from datetime import date, datetime, timezone
    from .schemas import HubComparisonRequest
    from .weather import WeatherRequest, finite
    from .weather_sources import WeatherSources
    from .noaa import NOAAClient
    
    BANDS={'snow':[5,15,25],'heavy_precipitation':[25,50,100],'wind':[50,75,100],'heat':[35,40,45],'cold':[-10,-20,-30]}
    VARIABLES={'snow':('snowfall_sum','cm'),'heavy_precipitation':('precipitation_sum','mm'),'wind':('wind_speed_10m_max','km/h'),'heat':('temperature_2m_max','C'),'cold':('temperature_2m_min','C')}
    PERIODS=(5,10,20,30)
    
    
    def daily_measure(rows,start,end,hazard,bands,recovery,frequency_benchmark,recovery_benchmark,weights):
        variable,unit=VARIABLES[hazard]
        observations={row['date']:row.get(variable) for row in rows if start.isoformat()<=row['date']<=end.isoformat()}
        expected=(end-start).days+1
        valid=sum(v is not None and finite(v) for v in observations.values())
        coverage=valid/expected
        # A missing date breaks an observed run; period peaks determine severity.
        from datetime import timedelta
        day=start; current=0; current_value=None; peaks=[]; peak_values=[]
        while day<=end:
            value=observations.get(day.isoformat()); level=0
            if value is not None and finite(value):
                for i,b in enumerate(bands):
                    if value<=b if hazard=='cold' else value>=b:level=i+1
            if level:
                current=max(current,level)
                current_value=value if current_value is None else (min(current_value,value) if hazard=='cold' else max(current_value,value))
            elif current:
                peaks.append(current);peak_values.append(current_value);current=0;current_value=None
            day+=timedelta(days=1)
        if current:peaks.append(current);peak_values.append(current_value)
        years=(end.year-start.year+1)
        frequency=len(peaks)/years
        severity=sum(x/3*100 for x in peaks)/len(peaks) if peaks else 0
        recovery_mean=sum(recovery[x-1] for x in peaks)/len(peaks) if peaks else 0
        frequency_score=min(100,frequency/frequency_benchmark*100)
        recovery_score=min(100,recovery_mean/recovery_benchmark*100)
        score=round((weights[0]*frequency_score+weights[1]*severity+weights[2]*recovery_score)/100,1) if coverage>=.8 else None
        return dict(start=start.isoformat(),end=end.isoformat(),coverage=round(coverage,4),valid_days=valid,expected_days=expected,
                    observed_periods=len(peaks),periods_per_year=round(frequency,2),average_severity_score=round(severity,1),
                    average_period_peak=round(sum(peak_values)/len(peak_values),2) if peak_values else None,most_extreme_period_peak=(min(peak_values) if hazard=='cold' else max(peak_values)) if peak_values else None,
                    assumed_average_recovery_days=round(recovery_mean,2),index=score,units=unit,bands=bands,
                    status='scored' if score is not None else 'insufficient_coverage',
                    limitation='Daily threshold periods are not named storms; missing days break periods. Recovery and benchmarks are illustrative; absence of events does not establish safety.')
    
    
    def compare_hubs(service,payload,now=None):
        config=HubComparisonRequest.model_validate(payload)
        from .storm_events import EVENT_TYPES, StormEventsClient
        locations=service.store.locations()
        if not set(config.locations)<=set(locations):raise ValueError('Unknown hub ID')
        daily=[x for x in config.hazards if x in BANDS]
        events=[x[6:] for x in config.hazards if x.startswith('event:') and x[6:] in EVENT_TYPES]
        if len(daily)+len(events)!=len(config.hazards):raise ValueError('Unknown weather event type')
        if set(config.bands)-set(daily):raise ValueError('Bands supplied for unselected weather type')
        bands={}
        for hazard in daily:
            values=config.bands.get(hazard,BANDS[hazard])
            if len(values)!=3 or any(not finite(v) for v in values) or len(set(values))!=3 or values!=sorted(values,reverse=hazard=='cold'):
                raise ValueError('Severity bands must have three ordered finite values for '+hazard)
            bands[hazard]=values
        end_year=(now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)).year-1
        end=date(end_year,12,31);start=date(end_year-29,1,1)
        response=dict(locations=[locations[x] for x in config.locations],end_year=end_year,periods=list(PERIODS),weights=config.weights,
                      assumptions=dict(bands=bands,event_benchmarks=config.event_benchmarks,recovery_days=config.recovery_days,frequency_benchmark=config.frequency_benchmark,recovery_benchmark=config.recovery_benchmark,minimum_coverage=.8,
                      warning='Illustrative planning index, not a probability, prediction, or operational loss estimate.'),hazards={})
        for hazard in daily:
            if not isinstance(service.weather,WeatherSources):raise ValueError('Weather provider does not support source selection')
            secondary=service.weather.secondary
            if isinstance(secondary,NOAAClient):secondary=NOAAClient(cache_dir=secondary.cache_dir,transport=secondary.transport,max_candidates=secondary.max_candidates,radius_km=secondary.radius_km,min_coverage=.8)
            client=WeatherSources(service.weather.primary,secondary,config.weather_source)
            result={i:dict(status='available',periods={}) for i in config.locations}
            # Each horizon is fetched independently so a station without 30 years of history
            # can still contribute a valid five-year analysis. Each horizon uses one source.
            for n in reversed(PERIODS):
                period_start=date(end_year-n+1,1,1)
                requests={i:WeatherRequest(locations[i]['latitude'],locations[i]['longitude'],period_start,end,locations[i]['timezone']) for i in config.locations}
                try:data=client.fetch_group(requests,hazard=hazard)
                except (RuntimeError,ValueError) as exc:data={i:exc for i in config.locations}
                for identifier in config.locations:
                    value=data[identifier]
                    if isinstance(value,Exception):
                        result[identifier]['periods'][str(n)]=dict(status='unavailable',error=str(value),index=None)
                        continue
                    measure=daily_measure(value['rows'],period_start,end,hazard,bands[hazard],config.recovery_days,config.frequency_benchmark,config.recovery_benchmark,config.weights)
                    measure['evidence']=value['evidence']
                    result[identifier]['periods'][str(n)]=measure
            response['hazards'][hazard]=dict(kind='daily',hubs=result)
        if events:
            try:
                event_results=StormEventsClient().compare(locations,config.locations,events,end_year,PERIODS,config.weights,config.frequency_benchmark,config.recovery_benchmark,config.recovery_days,config.event_benchmarks)
                response['hazards'].update({'event:'+k:v for k,v in event_results.items()})
            except (RuntimeError,ValueError) as exc:
                for name in events:response['hazards']['event:'+name]=dict(kind='reported_event',error=str(exc),hubs={})
        overall={}
        for n in PERIODS:
            values={}
            for identifier in config.locations:
                component=[]
                for result in response['hazards'].values():
                    index=result.get('hubs',{}).get(identifier,{}).get('periods',{}).get(str(n),{}).get('index')
                    if index is None:break
                    component.append(index)
                values[identifier]=round(sum(component)/len(component),1) if len(component)==len(config.hazards) and component else None
            # A comparison is incomplete when either side lacks any selected hazard.
            # Do not present a one-sided aggregate as a complete comparison.
            if any(value is None for value in values.values()):values={identifier:None for identifier in config.locations}
            overall[str(n)]=values
        response['overall']=overall
        return response

        def __call__(self,message,state,locations):

                return Intent(action='clarify',location_ids=[],hazard=None,start=None,end=None,threshold=None,question='Recorded event counts are not available for tornadoes, ice storms or drought. I can compare FEMA county-level relative expected-loss scores for these hazards.')
            if re.search(r'\b(?:what|which|list)\b.*\b(?:weather|hazards?|events?)\b.*\b(?:support|available|analy[sz]e|ask|answer|types?)\b|\b(?:supported|available)\s+(?:weather|hazards?|events?)\b',text):
                return Intent(action='capabilities',location_ids=[],hazard=None,start=None,end=None,threshold=None,question=None)
            if re.search(r'\bsnow\s*(?:depth|height|on the ground)\b',text):
                return Intent(action='clarify',location_ids=[],hazard=None,start=None,end=None,threshold=None,question='Snow depth on the ground is not available here. Ask about new snowfall per day instead.')
            if re.search(r'\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s*(?:cm|mm|inches|inch)\b',text):
                return Intent(action='clarify',location_ids=[],hazard=None,start=None,end=None,threshold=None,question='Demo mode cannot reliably interpret custom amounts. Use live AI mode or ask for heavy snow, defined here as more than 15 cm of new snowfall in a day.')
            if message.lstrip().startswith('{'):
                return Intent(action='clarify',location_ids=[],hazard=None,start=None,end=None,threshold=None,question='Paste network JSON into the Scenario JSON field below and click Run replay; the chat box expects a question.')
            previous=state.get('intent',{})
            base=dict(action='weather',location_ids=[],hazard=previous.get('hazard') or 'snow',start=previous.get('start'),end=previous.get('end'),threshold=previous.get('threshold'),question=None)
            if any(word in text for word in ['flight','blizzard','road closure']):
                return Intent(**dict(base,action='unsupported'))
            if 'replay' in text:return Intent(**dict(base,action='winter_replay'))
            ids=[i for i in locations if re.search(r'(?<!\w)'+re.escape(i.lower())+r'(?!\w)',text)]
            if 'midwest' in text:ids=[i for i,loc in locations.items() if loc.get('region','').lower()=='midwest']
            base['location_ids']=ids or previous.get('location_ids',[])
            named_risk=any(x in text for x in ('hurricane','flood','winter disruption','weather disruption risk','ice storm','tornado','drought'))
            risk_followup=previous.get('action')=='risk' and bool(ids) and not any(word in text for word in ('snow','heat','cold','rain','wind'))
            if (named_risk or risk_followup) and base['location_ids']:
                hazard=('hurricane_flood' if 'hurricane' in text and 'flood' in text else 'flood' if 'flood' in text else 'hurricane' if 'hurricane' in text else 'ice_storm' if 'ice storm' in text else 'tornado' if 'tornado' in text else 'drought' if 'drought' in text else 'winter' if 'winter' in text else previous.get('hazard') if risk_followup else 'overall')
                return Intent(**dict(base,action='risk',hazard=hazard,start=None,end=None,threshold=None))
            if any(word in text for word in ['why','explain']):return Intent(**dict(base,action='explain'))
            for word,hazard in [('snow','snow'),('rain','heavy_precipitation'),('heat','heat'),('cold','cold'),('wind','wind')]:
                if word in text:base['hazard']=hazard
            if base['hazard']!=previous.get('hazard'):base['threshold']=None
            if re.search(r'\bsnow(?:fall)?\b',text) and not re.search(r'\bheavy\s+snow(?:fall)?\b',text) and not re.search(r'\b(?:same|previous|that|those)\b',text):base['threshold']=None
            years=re.findall(r'\b(?:19|20)\d{2}\b',text)
            if years:
                base['start']=date(int(years[0]),1,1)
                base['end']=date(int(years[-1]),12,31)
            if 'last year' in text:
                year=datetime.now(timezone.utc).year-1
                base.update(start=date(year,1,1),end=date(year,12,31))
            if 'heavy snow' in text:base['threshold']=15
            if 'compare' in text or 'rank' in text:base['action']='compare'
            if not base['location_ids']:
                base.update(action='clarify',question='Register a location and include its ID in your question.')
            return Intent(**base)
    
    class Service:
        def __init__(self,store=None,weather=None,planner=None,mode='live',fema=None):
            self.store=store or Store()
            self.weather=weather or WeatherSources()
            self.mode=mode
            self.fema=fema or FEMAClient()
            self.planner=planner or (DemoPlanner() if mode=='demo' else build_planner())
    
        def add_location(self,payload):
            location=Location.model_validate(payload)
            # Validate timezone without performing a data request.
            WeatherRequest(location.latitude,location.longitude,date(2020,1,1),date(2020,1,2),location.timezone).parameters()
            self.store.add_location(location.model_dump())
            return location.model_dump()
    
        def weather_analysis(self,location_id,start,end,hazard,threshold=None,dataset=None):
            locations=self.store.locations()
            if location_id not in locations:raise ValueError('Unknown location ID: '+location_id)
            if end<start or (end-start).days>10957 or start.year<1940:
                raise ValueError('Weather analysis supports up to 10958 days starting in 1940 or later')
            location=locations[location_id]
            try:
                request=WeatherRequest(location['latitude'],location['longitude'],start,end,location['timezone'])
                data=dataset if dataset is not None else (self.weather.fetch(request,hazard=hazard) if isinstance(self.weather,WeatherSources) else self.weather.fetch(request))
                if isinstance(data,Exception):raise data
            except RuntimeError as exc:
                raise RuntimeError(f'Weather data for {location_id} ({start} through {end}): {exc}') from exc
            result=exposure(data['rows'],start,end,hazard,threshold)
            result.update(location_id=location_id,evidence=data['evidence'],trend=trend(result['annual'],start.year,end.year))
            return result
    
        def replay(self,payload,weather_snapshot=None):
            scenario=ScenarioInput.model_validate(payload)
            hubs=[Hub(**h.model_dump()) for h in scenario.hubs]
            demands=[Demand(**d.model_dump()) for d in scenario.demands]
            links={(l.hub_id,l.demand_id):l.distance_km for l in scenario.links}
            if len(links)!=len(scenario.links):raise ValueError('Duplicate distance link')
            validate(hubs,demands,links,scenario.max_distance_km,[])
            hub_ids={h.id for h in hubs}
            if set(scenario.hub_locations)!=hub_ids:raise ValueError('Every hub requires exactly one registered weather location')
            locations=self.store.locations()
            events,evidence=[],[]
            weather_rows={}
            profile=WinterProfile()
            if weather_snapshot is None and hasattr(self.weather,'fetch_group'):
                identifiers=set(scenario.hub_locations.values())
                if not identifiers<=set(locations):raise ValueError('Unknown weather location')
                requests={i:WeatherRequest(locations[i]['latitude'],locations[i]['longitude'],scenario.start,scenario.end,locations[i]['timezone']) for i in identifiers}
                weather_snapshot=self.weather.fetch_group(requests,hazard='snow')
            for hub in hubs:
                identifier=scenario.hub_locations[hub.id]
                if identifier not in locations:raise ValueError('Unknown weather location: '+identifier)
                loc=locations[identifier]
                dataset=(weather_snapshot[identifier] if weather_snapshot is not None else
                         self.weather.fetch(WeatherRequest(loc['latitude'],loc['longitude'],scenario.start,scenario.end,loc['timezone'])))
                if isinstance(dataset,Exception):raise dataset
                expected=(scenario.end-scenario.start).days+1
                if len(dataset['rows'])!=expected:raise ValueError('Replay requires every date')
                weather_rows[hub.id]=dataset['rows']
                events.extend(snowfall_disruptions(hub.id,dataset['rows'],profile))
                evidence.append(dict(hub_id=hub.id,**dataset['evidence']))
            result=evaluate(hubs,demands,links,scenario.max_distance_km,scenario.start,scenario.end,events)
            enrich_report(result,hubs,demands,weather_rows,profile)
            result.update(profile=profile.describe(),evidence=evidence,weather_trigger_days=len(events),
                          limitation='Matching reported dates replayed; source-specific observation windows and subdaily overlap are not modeled. No annual loss probabilities inferred.')
            return result
    
        def chat(self,payload):
            from .schemas import ChatRequest
            request=ChatRequest.model_validate(payload)

            intent=capability if capability.action=='capabilities' or is_event_count else Intent.model_validate(self.planner(request.message,state,self.store.locations()).model_dump())

            elif intent.action=='explain':

                hazards={'winter':['winter'],'hurricane':['hurricane'],'flood':['inland_flood','coastal_flood'],'hurricane_flood':['hurricane','inland_flood','coastal_flood'],'overall':['winter','hurricane','inland_flood','coastal_flood'],'ice_storm':['ice_storm'],'tornado':['tornado'],'drought':['drought']}.get(intent.hazard)
                if not hazards:raise ValueError('Specify a supported county hazard')
                for loc in intent.location_ids:
                    fips=locations[loc].get('county_fips')
                    if not fips:

                    try:

                        result['location_id']=loc
                        result['selected_scores']={h:result['scores'][h] for h in hazards}
                        if any(v is None for v in result['selected_scores'].values()):data_errors.append(dict(location_id=loc,error='One or more selected hazard scores unavailable'))
                        result['screening_score']=max(result['selected_scores'].values()) if all(v is not None for v in result['selected_scores'].values()) else None
                        risk_results.append(result)
                    except (RuntimeError,ValueError) as exc:data_errors.append(dict(location_id=loc,error=str(exc)))
                complete=not data_errors
                if complete and len(hazards)==1:risk_results.sort(key=lambda r:(-r['screening_score'],r['location_id']))
                def name(item):return item['location_id'].replace('example_','Example ').replace('_',' ').title()
                if complete and len(hazards)==1 and len(risk_results)>1:
                    top=risk_results[0]['screening_score']
                    leaders=[name(item) for item in risk_results if item['screening_score']==top]
                    label=hazards[0].replace('_',' ')
                    answer=(' and '.join(leaders)+' rank'+('s' if len(leaders)==1 else '')+' highest among the selected hubs for the '+label+' county screening measure.\n\n')
                    answer+='\n'.join(f"{index}. {name(item)}: {item['screening_score']:.1f} out of 100" for index,item in enumerate(risk_results,1))
                else:
                    answer=('County hazard comparison:' if complete else 'Comparison incomplete; no complete ranking.')
                    for item in risk_results:
                        answer+='\n'+name(item)+': '+', '.join(k.replace('_',' ')+' '+(f'{v:.1f} out of 100' if v is not None else 'unavailable') for k,v in item['selected_scores'].items())+'.'
                answer+='\n\nWhat this means: FEMA compares each county\'s estimated annual community losses for the hazard with counties nationwide; a higher score means a higher relative ranking. These figures reflect county-wide people and property, not facility-specific disruption probabilities or the chance a hub will close.'
                if len(hazards)>1:answer+=' Hazard categories are shown separately; the highest component is an illustrative screening indicator, not a FEMA composite.'
                if data_errors:answer+='\n\nMissing evidence: '+ '; '.join(e['location_id']+': '+e['error'] for e in data_errors)+'.'
                state['intent']=intent.model_dump(mode='json')
                state['last_answer']=answer
                state['last_risk_results']=risk_results
                state['last_data_errors']=data_errors
            elif intent.action=='winter_replay':
                if not state.get('scenario'):
                    answer='Supply a network in the scenario form, then ask for a winter replay. I will not invent facilities, capacities or backup links.'
                else:
                    scenario_result=self.replay(state['scenario'])
                    answer=(f"Winter replay: {scenario_result['incremental_unserved_demand_days']:.2f} incremental unserved demand-days; "
                            f"minimum daily service {100*scenario_result['minimum_served_fraction']:.1f}%. Capacity loss and recovery are illustrative assumptions, not observed closures.")
                    state['last_answer']=answer
            else:
                if intent.hazard not in (None, 'snow', 'heavy_precipitation', 'heat', 'cold', 'wind'):
                    raise ValueError('Historical weather requires a supported weather hazard')
                if not 1<=len(intent.location_ids)<=5:raise ValueError('Select between one and five registered locations')
                if len(intent.location_ids)!=len(set(intent.location_ids)):raise ValueError('Duplicate location IDs')
                start=intent.start or date(2011,1,1)
                end=intent.end or date(2025,12,31)
                hazard=intent.hazard or 'snow'
                snapshot=None

                    registered=self.store.locations()
                    if not set(intent.location_ids)<=set(registered):raise ValueError('Unknown location ID')
                    if end<start or (end-start).days>10957 or start.year<1940:raise ValueError('Invalid or excessive weather period')
                    requests={i:WeatherRequest(registered[i]['latitude'],registered[i]['longitude'],start,end,registered[i]['timezone']) for i in intent.location_ids}
                    selected=self.weather
                    if request.weather_source is not None:
                        if not isinstance(self.weather,WeatherSources):raise ValueError('Weather source selection is not supported by this weather provider')
                        selected=WeatherSources(primary=self.weather.primary,secondary=self.weather.secondary,source=request.weather_source)
                    snapshot=selected.fetch_group(requests,hazard=hazard)
                for loc in intent.location_ids:
                    try:
                        cards.append(self.weather_analysis(loc,start,end,hazard,intent.threshold,dataset=snapshot[loc] if snapshot is not None else None))
                    except RuntimeError as exc:
                        if intent.action!='compare':raise
                        data_errors.append(dict(location_id=loc,error=str(exc)))
                if intent.action=='compare' and data_errors:
                    answer='Comparison incomplete: no complete ranking was produced. Unavailable locations: '+', '.join(e['location_id'] for e in data_errors)+'. '
                    answer+=' '.join(e['error'] for e in data_errors)+' Available results: '
                elif intent.action=='compare':
                    ranked=rank_exposure(cards)
                    cards=ranked['ranked']
                    excluded=ranked['excluded']
                    answer='Ranked by exceedance-day percentage. '+('Excluded for inadequate coverage: '+', '.join(excluded)+'. ' if excluded else '')
                else:answer=''
                answer+=' '.join(self.describe(r) for r in cards)
                intent=intent.model_copy(update=dict(start=start,end=end,hazard=hazard))
                state['intent']=intent.model_dump(mode='json')
                state['last_answer']=answer
                state['last_risk_results']=[]
                state['last_data_errors']=data_errors
            planning=dict(mode=self.mode,model_plan=original_plan,applied_plan=intent.model_dump(mode='json'),policy_adjustments=adjustments,model_response=getattr(self.planner,'last_metadata',None))
            state['last_planning']=planning
            state['last_mode']=self.mode
            self.store.save(identifier,state)
            return dict(conversation_id=identifier,answer=answer,cards=cards,risk_results=risk_results,scenario_result=scenario_result,mode=self.mode,data_errors=data_errors,result_status='partial' if data_errors else 'complete',planning=planning,model_config=(self.planner.config.public() if hasattr(self.planner,'config') else dict(provider='demo',model='deterministic-parser',configured=True)),intent=intent.model_dump(mode='json'),

        @staticmethod
        def describe(r):
            if r['exceedance_percent'] is None:return r['location_id']+': insufficient valid data.'
            label={'snowfall_sum':'snowfall','precipitation_sum':'heavy precipitation','temperature_2m_max':'hot weather','temperature_2m_min':'cold weather','wind_speed_10m_max':'strong winds'}[r['variable']]
            name=r['location_id'].replace('_',' ').title()
            start,end=r['start'][:4],r['end'][:4]
            period=start if start==end and r['start'].endswith('01-01') and r['end'].endswith('12-31') else f"{r['start']} to {r['end']}"
            qualifying='heavy snowfall' if r['variable']=='snowfall_sum' and r['threshold']>0 else label
            answer=f"In {period}, {name} had {qualifying} on about {r['exceedance_percent']:.1f}% of days with available data."
            if r['observed_event_runs']:
                answer+=f" The longest consecutive period lasted {r['longest_observed_run_days']} {'day' if r['longest_observed_run_days']==1 else 'days'}."
            if r['missing_days']:answer+=f" Some days are missing from the record ({r['missing_days']} days)."
            return answer

    class StrictModel(BaseModel):

        latitude: float=Field(ge=-90,le=90)
        longitude: float=Field(ge=-180,le=180)
        timezone: str=Field(min_length=1,max_length=80)
    
    class Intent(StrictModel):
        action: Literal['weather','compare','risk','capabilities','winter_replay','explain','clarify','unsupported']
        location_ids: list[str]
        hazard: Literal['snow','heavy_precipitation','heat','cold','wind','winter','hurricane','flood','hurricane_flood','overall','ice_storm','tornado','drought'] | None
        start: date | None
        end: date | None
        threshold: float | None
        question: str | None
    
    class ChatRequest(StrictModel):
        message: str=Field(min_length=1,max_length=4000)
        conversation_id: str | None=None
        scenario: dict | None=None
        weather_source: Literal['auto','open-meteo','noaa'] | None=None
    
    class HubComparisonRequest(StrictModel):
        locations: list[str] = Field(min_length=2,max_length=2)
        hazards: list[str] = Field(min_length=1,max_length=60)
        weather_source: Literal['auto','open-meteo','noaa']='auto'
        weights: list[float]=Field(default=[50,25,25],min_length=3,max_length=3)
        frequency_benchmark: float=Field(default=10,gt=0,le=10000)
        recovery_benchmark: float=Field(default=14,gt=0,le=365)
        recovery_days: list[float]=Field(default=[1,3,7],min_length=3,max_length=3)
        bands: dict[str,list[float]]=Field(default_factory=dict)
        event_benchmarks: dict[str,float]=Field(default_factory=lambda: {'hail_inches':3,'wind_knots':100})
        @model_validator(mode='after')
        def check_comparison(self):
            if len(set(self.locations))!=2:raise ValueError('Choose two distinct hubs')
            if len(set(self.hazards))!=len(self.hazards):raise ValueError('Choose each hazard once')
            if any(x<0 for x in self.weights) or abs(sum(self.weights)-100)>0.01:raise ValueError('Weights must be nonnegative and sum to 100')
            if any(x<0 or x>365 for x in self.recovery_days) or self.recovery_days!=sorted(self.recovery_days):raise ValueError('Recovery values must be ordered from 0 to 365 days')
            if set(self.event_benchmarks)!={'hail_inches','wind_knots'} or any(value<=0 for value in self.event_benchmarks.values()):raise ValueError('Event severity benchmarks must be positive')
            return self
    
    class HubInput(StrictModel):
        id: str
        capacity: float=Field(gt=0)
        component: Literal['contiguous_us','alaska','hawaii']='contiguous_us'
    
    class DemandInput(StrictModel):
        id: str
        units: float=Field(ge=0)
        component: Literal['contiguous_us','alaska','hawaii']='contiguous_us'
    
    class LinkInput(StrictModel):
        hub_id: str
        demand_id: str
        distance_km: float=Field(ge=0)
    
    class ScenarioInput(StrictModel):
        hubs: list[HubInput]=Field(min_length=1,max_length=30)

    import tempfile
    import unittest
    
    from app.agent import Service
    from app.hubs import seed_examples
    from app.storage import Store
    from evals.run import EvaluationFEMA, EvaluationWeather
    
    
    class RiskConversationTests(unittest.TestCase):
        def setUp(self):
            self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
            self.service = Service(Store(self.tmp.name + '/app.db'), EvaluationWeather(), mode='demo', fema=EvaluationFEMA())
            seed_examples(self.service.store)
    
        def tearDown(self):
            self.tmp.cleanup()
    
        def test_midwest_winter_ranking_and_stable_ties(self):
            result = self.service.chat({'message': 'Which hubs in the Midwest are most exposed to winter disruption?'})
            self.assertEqual(result['result_status'], 'complete')
            self.assertEqual([r['location_id'] for r in result['risk_results']], ['chicago', 'minneapolis', 'detroit'])
            self.assertIn('county', result['answer'])
            self.assertIn('not facility-specific', result['answer'])
            self.assertIn('Chicago ranks highest', result['answer'])
            self.assertIn('counties nationwide', result['answer'])
    
        def test_risk_followups_preserve_hubs_hazard_and_evidence(self):
            first = self.service.chat({'message': 'Compare Miami and Houston for hurricane and flood'})
            cid = first['conversation_id']
            second = self.service.chat({'message': 'Compare only flooding', 'conversation_id': cid})
            self.assertEqual(second['intent']['hazard'], 'flood')
            self.assertEqual(set(second['intent']['location_ids']), {'miami', 'houston'})
            explain = self.service.chat({'message': 'Why?', 'conversation_id': cid})
            self.assertEqual(explain['risk_results'], second['risk_results'])
            follow = self.service.chat({'message': 'What about Dallas?', 'conversation_id': cid})
            self.assertEqual(follow['intent']['hazard'], 'flood')
            self.assertEqual(follow['intent']['location_ids'], ['dallas'])
    
        def test_missing_data_stays_partial_in_explanation(self):
            class Missing(EvaluationFEMA):
                def fetch(self, county_fips):
                    result = super().fetch(county_fips)
                    result['scores']['coastal_flood'] = None
                    return result
            self.service.fema = Missing()
            first = self.service.chat({'message': 'Compare Miami and Houston for flood'})
            self.assertEqual(first['result_status'], 'partial')
            self.assertIn('no complete ranking', first['answer'])
            self.assertTrue(all(r['screening_score'] is None for r in first['risk_results']))
            explanation = self.service.chat({'message': 'Why?', 'conversation_id': first['conversation_id']})
            self.assertEqual(explanation['result_status'], 'partial')
    
        def test_risk_then_snow_uses_weather(self):
            first = self.service.chat({'message': 'Hurricane risk for Dallas'})
            follow = self.service.chat({'message': 'Snow in Dallas in 2025', 'conversation_id': first['conversation_id']})
            self.assertEqual(follow['intent']['action'], 'weather')
            self.assertEqual(follow['cards'][0]['variable'], 'snowfall_sum')
    
        def test_other_hazards_are_county_screening_not_observed_counts(self):
            for hazard in ('ice storm','tornado','drought'):
                result=self.service.chat({'message':f'Compare chicago and dallas for {hazard} risk'})
                self.assertEqual(result['intent']['action'],'risk')
                self.assertEqual(result['result_status'],'complete')
                self.assertIn('county',result['answer'].lower())
            count=self.service.chat({'message':'How many tornadoes were recorded in dallas?'})
            self.assertEqual(count['intent']['action'],'clarify')
            self.assertIn('not available',count['answer'])
    
    
    if __name__ == '__main__':
        unittest.main()
    """Conversation evaluation with explicit synthetic weather. --live-model calls configured provider."""
    import argparse
    from datetime import datetime,timedelta,timezone
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    import tempfile
    from time import perf_counter,sleep
    from app.agent import Service
    from app.storage import Store
    from app.providers import ModelConfig
    from app.hubs import seed_examples
    
    class EvaluationWeather:
        def fetch(self,request):
            rows=[]
            day=request.start
            while day<=request.end:
                rows.append(dict(date=day.isoformat(),snowfall_sum=10 if day.day==1 else 0,temperature_2m_max=36,temperature_2m_min=-15,precipitation_sum=0,wind_speed_10m_max=0))
                day+=timedelta(days=1)
            return dict(rows=rows,evidence=dict(source_id='fixture:evaluation',source='Synthetic evaluation data'))
    
    class EvaluationFEMA:
        """Explicit synthetic county scores for repeatable model evaluations."""
        def fetch(self,county_fips):
            values={'17031':90,'26163':70,'27053':80,'12086':85,'48201':95,'48113':60,'08031':40,'99999':50}
            score=values[county_fips]
            return dict(county_fips=county_fips,county='Synthetic',state='XX',
                        scores=dict(winter=score,hurricane=score,inland_flood=score,coastal_flood=score,ice_storm=score,tornado=score,drought=score),
                        evidence=dict(source_id='fixture:evaluation-fema',source='Synthetic FEMA evaluation data'))
    
    def main():
        p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
        p.add_argument('--live-model',action='store_true')
        p.add_argument('--report',type=Path)
        p.add_argument('--delay-seconds',type=float,default=0,help='Pause between cases to respect provider rate limits')
        args=p.parse_args()
        if args.delay_seconds<0:p.error('--delay-seconds must be nonnegative')
        cases=json.loads(Path(__file__).with_name('cases.json').read_text())
        config=ModelConfig.load().public() if args.live_model else dict(provider='demo',model='deterministic-parser',configured=True)
        results=[]
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            service=Service(Store(directory+'/eval.db'),EvaluationWeather(),mode='live' if args.live_model else 'demo',fema=EvaluationFEMA())
            seed_examples(service.store)
            for identifier in ['siteA','siteB']:
                service.store.add_location(dict(id=identifier,latitude=40,longitude=-105,timezone='UTC',county_fips='99999'))
            conversation=None
            for case in cases:
                if results and args.delay_seconds:sleep(args.delay_seconds)
                if case.get('new_conversation'):conversation=None
                began=perf_counter()
                item=dict(message=case['message'],passed=False)
                try:
                    response=service.chat(dict(message=case['message'],conversation_id=conversation))
                    conversation=response['conversation_id']
                    item['intent']=response['intent']
                    item['planning']=response.get('planning')
                    raw_plan=response.get('planning',{}).get('model_plan',{})
                    item['raw_model_plan_matches_expected']=all(raw_plan.get(k)==case[k] for k in ('action','hazard','threshold') if k in case)
                    assert response['intent']['action']==case['action'],'Wrong action'
                    if 'hazard' in case:assert response['intent']['hazard']==case['hazard'],'Wrong hazard'
                    if 'threshold' in case:assert response['intent']['threshold']==case['threshold'],'Wrong threshold'
                    if 'locations' in case:assert set(response['intent']['location_ids'])==set(case['locations']),'Wrong locations'
                    if response['cards']:
                        assert all(c['evidence']['source_id']=='fixture:evaluation' for c in response['cards']),'Missing evidence'
                        if case.get('hazard')=='heat':
                            assert all(c['exceedance_percent']==100 for c in response['cards']),'Wrong heat calculation'
                    if response.get('risk_results'):
                        assert all(r['evidence']['source_id']=='fixture:evaluation-fema' for r in response['risk_results']),'Missing county evidence'
                    if case.get('risk_count') is not None:
                        assert len(response.get('risk_results',[]))==case['risk_count'],'Wrong risk result count'
                        assert response['result_status']=='complete','Risk result incomplete'
                    item['passed']=True
                    print('PASS',case['message'])
                except Exception as exc:
                    item['error']=str(exc)
                    print('FAIL',case['message'],str(exc))
                item['latency_seconds']=round(perf_counter()-began,3)
                results.append(item)
        passed=sum(r['passed'] for r in results)
        report=dict(created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),model_config=config,weather='synthetic evaluation fixtures',hazards='synthetic county fixtures',passed=passed,total=len(cases),cases=results)
        if args.report:
            args.report.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            args.report.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
            print('Report:',args.report)
        print(f'{passed}/{len(cases)} passed | {config["provider"]} / {config["model"]} | synthetic weather')
        return passed!=len(cases)
    
    if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main())

        """Portable hidden-key launcher for the local weather analyst."""
        import argparse
        import getpass
        import os
        from pathlib import Path
        import re
        import subprocess
        import sys
        
        ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
        
        def main(argv=None):
            parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
            parser.add_argument('--provider',choices=['groq','openai'],default='groq')
            parser.add_argument('--model',default=None)
            parser.add_argument('--weather-source',choices=['auto','open-meteo','noaa'],default='auto')
            parser.add_argument('--action',choices=['serve','evaluate'],default='serve')
            parser.add_argument('--port',type=int,default=8000)
            args=parser.parse_args(argv)
            if not 1<=args.port<=65535:parser.error('--port must be between 1 and 65535')
            model=args.model or ('openai/gpt-oss-20b' if args.provider=='groq' else None)
            if not model:parser.error('--model is required for OpenAI')
            variable='GROQ_API_KEY' if args.provider=='groq' else 'OPENAI_API_KEY'
            environment=os.environ.copy()
            if not environment.get(variable):
                try:key=getpass.getpass(f'Enter your {args.provider} API key (hidden): ').strip()
                except (EOFError,KeyboardInterrupt):print('\nCancelled.',file=sys.stderr);return 1
                if not key:print('No key entered.',file=sys.stderr);return 1
                environment[variable]=key
            environment.update(LLM_PROVIDER=args.provider,LLM_MODEL=model,WEATHER_SOURCE=args.weather_source)
            if args.action=='evaluate':
                safe_model=re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+','-',model)
                command=[sys.executable,'-m','evals.run','--live-model','--delay-seconds','10','--report',f'eval-results/{args.provider}-{safe_model}.json']
            else:
                command=[sys.executable,'-m','app.server','--port',str(args.port)]
            print(f'Provider: {args.provider} | Model: {model} | Weather: {args.weather_source}',flush=True)
            try:return subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,env=environment,check=False).returncode
            except KeyboardInterrupt:return 130
        
        if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main())

    import os
    import unittest
    from unittest.mock import patch
    from scripts import start_live
    
    class LauncherTests(unittest.TestCase):
        def test_hidden_key_is_passed_only_through_child_environment(self):
            with patch.dict(os.environ,{},clear=True),patch('scripts.start_live.getpass.getpass',return_value='test-secret') as prompt,patch('scripts.start_live.subprocess.run') as run:
                run.return_value.returncode=0
                self.assertEqual(start_live.main(['--port','8765']),0)
                prompt.assert_called_once()
                command=run.call_args.args[0];kwargs=run.call_args.kwargs
                self.assertNotIn('test-secret',' '.join(command))
                self.assertEqual(kwargs['env']['GROQ_API_KEY'],'test-secret')
                self.assertNotIn('GROQ_API_KEY',os.environ)
    
        def test_existing_key_is_reused_and_evaluation_is_paced(self):
            with patch.dict(os.environ,{'GROQ_API_KEY':'existing'},clear=True),patch('scripts.start_live.getpass.getpass') as prompt,patch('scripts.start_live.subprocess.run') as run:
                run.return_value.returncode=0
                self.assertEqual(start_live.main(['--action','evaluate']),0)
                prompt.assert_not_called()
                self.assertIn('--delay-seconds',run.call_args.args[0])
    
    if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()

    docs/example-questions.md:29:FEMA scores are national county percentiles for estimated annual community losses; they are not the probability of a hub disruption. They include community people and property, not the vulnerability or downtime of a specific facility. Sources, vintage, coverage and limitations are available with the results.
    docs/example-questions.md:31:Ice storm, tornado and drought results are county-level FEMA screening scores. They are not counts or dates of recorded weather events. Missing values remain unavailable. The app cannot currently count recorded tornadoes, ice storms or drought events.
    docs/example-questions.md:35:Use the **Weather data source** selector above the chat input: Automatic (ERA5 with NOAA fallback), Open-Meteo ERA5 only, or NOAA station observations only. It applies to historical-weather chat analyses; FEMA risk screening always uses FEMA. The JSON API accepts optional `weather_source` values `auto`, `open-meteo`, or `noaa`; omitting it retains the server default. Each comparison uses one weather source, never a mixture. NOAA maximum wind is unavailable. The two sources use different measurements and daily conventions, so values may differ.
    docs/example-questions.md:43:The 0–100 planning index is not a probability of disruption. Its default weights are 50% frequency, 25% mean severity and 25% assumed recovery; the user can edit weights, bands, recovery and normalization benchmarks. For daily data, frequency is qualifying periods per year, normalized to 10 periods/year; severity is the mean peak band as a fraction of the three bands; recovery is the mean illustrative 1/3/7 days normalized to 14 days. Each component is capped at 100. No qualifying periods yield zero components, but do not demonstrate safety. The overall index is the mean of selected hazard indices and is withheld if either hub has any unscored hazard. Categories may overlap, and this index has not been calibrated to facility losses.
    docs/example-questions.md:45:All 48 standard NOAA event categories are offered. The first release scores hail size, wind magnitude and EF-rated tornadoes when enough physical magnitude values are present; other categories remain unscored but display available counts. NOAA archives can be slow to download the first time. County reports apply to counties, not facilities; statewide fallbacks can include events far away. A warning appears when statewide or mixed geographic scopes are used, including when scores are shown. Historical reporting practices, event classification and archive delays vary. NOAA data does not establish actual outage duration.
    docs/example-questions.md:64:The app does not identify named storms, blizzards, snow depth on the ground, freezing rain, tornado tracks, actual road closures or flight cancellations. Flood, hurricane, ice storm, tornado and drought screening questions use FEMA county-level indicators rather than recorded event counts. Example hubs have county mapping; catalog entries need a county mapping for FEMA county screening. Ask about rain rather than interpreting heavy precipitation as a flood probability.
    docs/example-questions.md:68:The application uses three source families: Open-Meteo's ERA5 historical weather reanalysis, NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily station observations as a fallback for snowfall, precipitation and temperatures, NOAA NCEI Storm Events reports for event comparisons, and FEMA's National Risk Index for county-level hazard screening. NOAA fallback does not provide the app's maximum-wind metric. ERA5 and NOAA observations are not silently mixed in one comparison. These sources have broad United States coverage, including Alaska and Hawaii, but a specific coordinate, variable and time period may have inadequate station observations or missing FEMA data. The application has not validated every state or every location; coverage is reported per result. The 25 illustrative locations do not represent national hub coverage.
    docs/example-questions.md:72:Start demo mode with `python -m app.server --demo`. It uses a limited keyword parser, not an AI model, and may misunderstand different phrasing. Click **New conversation** when switching topics if a follow-up inherits unwanted context. Start live mode with `.\scripts\start-live.ps1` for natural-language model planning; it prompts for a key without displaying it. Both modes use real weather and FEMA sources or their caches; if a provider is unavailable the app reports the failure.
    README.md:3:A local conversational analyst for historical weather exposure and county-level natural hazard screening. The catalog contains 25 illustrative city locations, including seven example existing hubs; none are verified company facilities.

            follow = self.service.chat({'message': 'What about Dallas?', 'conversation_id': cid})
            self.assertEqual(follow['intent']['hazard'], 'flood')
            self.assertEqual(follow['intent']['location_ids'], ['dallas'])

            first = self.service.chat({'message': 'Compare Miami and Houston for flood'})
            self.assertEqual(first['result_status'], 'partial')
            self.assertIn('not enough comparable evidence', first['answer'])
            self.assertTrue(all(x is None for x in first['comparison_result']['overall']['10'].values()))
            explanation = self.service.chat({'message': 'Why?', 'conversation_id': first['conversation_id']})

## Selection and actions

- Clicking a map marker or city in the list selects it. Clicking a selected city removes it; selecting a third prompts the user to remove one first.

    """Local single-user HTTP API and chat. Run: python -m app.server [--demo]."""
    import argparse
    from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
    import json
    import os
    from pathlib import Path
    from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError
    from pydantic import ValidationError
    from .agent import Service
    from .winter import WinterProfile
    from .providers import ModelConfig
    
    STATIC=Path(__file__).parent/'static'
    
    def dispatch(service,path,payload):
        if path=='/api/scenarios/compare':
            from .comparison import compare_networks
            return compare_networks(service,payload)
        if path=='/api/chat':return service.chat(payload)
        if path=='/api/hub-comparison':
            from .hub_comparison import compare_hubs
            return compare_hubs(service,payload)
        if path=='/api/scenarios/replay':return service.replay(payload)
        raise KeyError('Unknown endpoint')
    
    def make_handler(service,port):
        class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            def log_message(self,format,*args):
                # Do not log chat bodies, tokens or query strings.
                return
            def send_json(self,status,payload):
                raw=json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False).encode()
                self.send_response(status)
                self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json; charset=utf-8')
                self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(raw)))
                self.send_header('Cache-Control','no-store')
                self.send_header('X-Content-Type-Options','nosniff')
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(raw)
            def do_GET(self):
                if self.path=='/api/health':
                    return self.send_json(200,dict(status='ok',mode=service.mode,llm_configured=ModelConfig.load().public()['configured'],model_config=ModelConfig.load().public(),weather_source=os.environ.get('WEATHER_SOURCE','auto'),chat_weather_source_selection=True))
                if self.path=='/api/locations':return self.send_json(200,list(service.store.locations().values()))
                if self.path=='/api/comparison-options':
                    from .storm_events import EVENT_TYPES
                    from .hub_comparison import BANDS
                    return self.send_json(200,dict(daily_hazards=BANDS,noaa_event_types=EVENT_TYPES,periods=[5,10,20,30],open_meteo_catalog_url='https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/historical-weather-api',catalog_note='The provider documents additional variables; only the daily hazards listed here are scored.'))
                if self.path=='/api/profile':return self.send_json(200,WinterProfile().describe())
                files={'/':'index.html','/app.js':'app.js','/style.css':'style.css','/us-states.json':'us-states.json'}
                if self.path not in files:return self.send_json(404,dict(error='Not found'))
                path=STATIC/files[self.path]
                raw=path.read_bytes()
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header('Content-Type',{'html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','js':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','json':'application/json; charset=utf-8'}[path.suffix[1:]])
                self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(raw)))
                self.send_header('Content-Security-Policy',"default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'")
                self.send_header('X-Content-Type-Options','nosniff')
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(raw)

    +The summary names a lower index only when both locations have comparable scores. It identifies partial comparisons and displays available NOAA report counts even when there is not enough severity evidence for a score. Counts describe county or state areas, not hub incidents; different geographic scopes and reporting gaps prevent a reliable facility-risk conclusion. For daily weather, a historical planning-index trend is shown only for the selected period when it spans at least 15 years and has sufficient eligible annual observations; a 5- or 10-year view cannot establish a trend under that standard. Trend intervals are approximate, assume stationary residual dependence and do not predict future weather.
    +
     The 0–100 planning index is not a probability of disruption. Its default weights are 50% frequency, 25% mean severity and 25% assumed recovery; the user can edit weights, bands, recovery and normalization benchmarks. For daily data, frequency is qualifying periods per year, normalized to 10 periods/year; severity is the mean peak band as a fraction of the three bands; recovery is the mean illustrative 1/3/7 days normalized to 14 days. Each component is capped at 100. No qualifying periods yield zero components, but do not demonstrate safety. The overall index is the mean of hazards that have a score for every ranked location; it is marked partial when any hazard or location is excluded. Chat and table comparisons share the same settings and default to the last 10 complete years for chat when no dates are provided. Categories may overlap, and this index has not been calibrated to facility losses.

## Assistant

Open the demo at [http://127.0.0.1:8792](http://127.0.0.1:8792), then:

1. **Choose locations** by clicking their dots on the map or their names in the list. You can select up to two.
2. **Choose a weather event** and a time period.
3. Click **Compare in chat** to put a question in the chat box. Review or edit it, then send it.
4. Click **Full comparison table** to compare the selected event across all four available periods: 5, 10, 20 and 30 years. Open the details for supporting data and limitations.
5. Click **Reset locations** to start a new selection. Your chat and the previous table stay visible.

For one selected location, the button says **Ask in chat** instead. You can also type questions directly without using the map.

The planning index combines frequency, severity and recovery assumptions; a lower score indicates lower exposure under those assumptions. It is **not a percentage or a prediction of shutdown**. Where there isn’t enough information for a score, the app shows available NOAA report counts and explains their limitations.

    """Portable hidden-key launcher for the local weather analyst."""
    import argparse
    import getpass
    import os
    from pathlib import Path
    import re
    import subprocess
    import sys
    
    ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    
    def main(argv=None):
        parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
        parser.add_argument('--provider',choices=['groq','openai'],default='groq')
        parser.add_argument('--model',default=None)
        parser.add_argument('--weather-source',choices=['auto','open-meteo','noaa'],default='auto')
        parser.add_argument('--action',choices=['serve','evaluate'],default='serve')
        parser.add_argument('--port',type=int,default=8000)
        args=parser.parse_args(argv)
        if not 1<=args.port<=65535:parser.error('--port must be between 1 and 65535')
        model=args.model or ('openai/gpt-oss-20b' if args.provider=='groq' else None)
        if not model:parser.error('--model is required for OpenAI')
        variable='GROQ_API_KEY' if args.provider=='groq' else 'OPENAI_API_KEY'
        environment=os.environ.copy()
        if not environment.get(variable):
            try:key=getpass.getpass(f'Enter your {args.provider} API key (hidden): ').strip()
            except (EOFError,KeyboardInterrupt):print('\nCancelled.',file=sys.stderr);return 1
            if not key:print('No key entered.',file=sys.stderr);return 1
            environment[variable]=key
        environment.update(LLM_PROVIDER=args.provider,LLM_MODEL=model,WEATHER_SOURCE=args.weather_source)
        if args.action=='evaluate':
            safe_model=re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+','-',model)
            command=[sys.executable,'-m','evals.run','--live-model','--delay-seconds','10','--report',f'eval-results/{args.provider}-{safe_model}.json']
        else:
            command=[sys.executable,'-m','app.server','--port',str(args.port)]
        print(f'Provider: {args.provider} | Model: {model} | Weather: {args.weather_source}',flush=True)
        try:return subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,env=environment,check=False).returncode
        except KeyboardInterrupt:return 130
    
    if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main())
